status.description: `null` when there was never a provisioning in this project. `awaiting_plan_decision` is an ADOPTED repository with a generated plan not yet decided: nothing runs until someone approves the plan or adopts it as is.

sessionId.description: The bootstrap's DEDICATED session. The progress screen reads its `bootstrap.step_*` events to build the live checklist.

attempts.description: How many times the bootstrap has already been attempted. It is idempotent and resumable: repeating doesn't duplicate what already worked.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
